fieldValues.title: Clerk in Group governance
fieldValues.summary: The person who takes the minutes in a group's meeting and keeps its record of decisions afterwards: muDemocracy's clerk, the persona most of its governance problems name.
goals: The minutes say what the group decided, in its own words
Every decision can be traced to the moment it was made
Nothing decided in the meeting is lost or misremembered
The record stays the group's, not a platform's
jobs: Take minutes while the meeting runs
Notice when the group has decided something
Point a minute at the words it came from
Bring a meeting into the group's corpus without retyping it
Keep the decision log current after the meeting
fieldValues.needs: To hear and follow the meeting while writing; help that proposes but never decides for them; a record that stays local and in the group's hands.
